stem_book: A collar of mass m is tied at one end of a spring of spring constant mg/R and unstretched length R/2, the other end being tied to a fixed point O (O lies R/2 below the centre of the semicircle on the vertical diameter AB, as shown). The smooth semicircular wire frame of radius R is fixed in a vertical plane. The collar is released from rest at the top point A. Find the normal reaction between the collar and the wire just before it reaches the lowest point B. (a) 3mg (b) 4mg (c) 5mg (d) 6mg
reason: stem made explicit: released from rest at A, O is R/2 below the centre (from figure)
work: at A extension = 3R/2 − R/2 = R, at B natural length; ½(mg/R)R² + mg·2R = ½mv² ⇒ v² = 5gR; N = mg + mv²/R = 6mg
